details: Escalating hostilities between the United States and Iran, including recent military strikes and naval actions, have driven Brent crude oil prices above $90 per barrel. This surge reflects growing fears of supply disruptions in the Middle East, particularly concerning the critical Strait of Hormuz, and fuels global inflation concerns, potentially impacting central bank monetary policies.
title: US-Iran Tensions Escalate, Brent Crude Surges Past $90

details: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has trimmed its global growth forecast for 2026 to 3.0% from earlier projections, while simultaneously raising its headline inflation forecast. The IMF's updated outlook highlights the economic impact of the ongoing war in the Middle East and a reassessment of artificial intelligence (AI) sector valuations as key risks, creating a challenging macroeconomic environment for global markets.
title: IMF Lowers 2026 Global Growth Forecast, Cites Geopolitical & AI Risks

details: Bitcoin has shown volatile performance, experiencing moderate gains after softer-than-expected US core inflation data briefly eased Federal Reserve rate hike expectations. However, renewed geopolitical tensions, particularly the US-Iran conflict driving up oil prices, and persistent hawkish rhetoric from Fed officials are injecting uncertainty into the market. Meanwhile, Ethereum has demonstrated relative strength, supported by robust DeFi and staking activity.
title: Bitcoin Volatile on Geopolitics & Inflation, Ethereum Outperforms
